title: CreateResult
description: Result of `rebar create … --output json` (and the library create_ticket(return_alias=True) / MCP create_ticket): {id, alias, title}. The default text form prints a human summary line then the bare id (| tail -1). `description_warning` is the advisory save-time notice when the new description exceeds `verify.max_ticket_description_chars` while the plan-review start-work gate is enabled (null otherwise); `duplicate_warning` is the advisory create-time notice when another create inside the recency window carries the same normalized title while `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` is enabled (null otherwise); `similar_tickets` is the ranked create-time advisory for tickets resembling this one in wording rather than in exact title, under the same `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` setting (empty otherwise). The two warnings are carried on the library and MCP results — the CLI emits them on stderr instead, keeping stdout pure in both output modes.

similar_tickets.description: Ranked tickets resembling the created one, most relevant first. Empty when retrieval is disabled, finds nothing, or fails; the created ticket never appears in its own results. Non-graph artifact types (session_log, code_review, identity) are never probed.

score.description: Relevance in the closed interval 0 to 1, 1 most relevant.

push_status.description: MCP results only: delivery status of this write (see common push_status).
